name: Puddle
summary: Flat oval rain puddle with a sky reflection and ripple rings; anim ripple sends rings out. For wet streets and paths.

params.name: y
params.note: the puddle lies on y (about 780 px wide at s = 1)

params.name: s
params.note: about 780 px wide and 105 px tall at s = 1

params.name: anim
params.note: ripple = rings spread out from a raindrop, looping
